hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in ''|*/node_modules/*|*/.next/*|*/.turbo/*|*/.source/*|*/coverage/*|*/dist/*|*/build/*|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/package-lock.json|*/yarn.lock|*/openapi.json) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$d/package.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/package.json" ] || exit 0; r=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 0; [ -x "$r/node_modules/.bin/prettier" ] || exit 0; (cd "$d" && "$r/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown "$f") >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in ''|*/node_modules/*|*/drawdb/*|*/.claude/settings.json) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; grep -nI '—' "$f" >&2 || exit 0; echo 'CLAUDE.md forbids the em dash. Replace it with a hyphen, a comma, or a rewrite.' >&2; exit 2; }
